title: Warped Wart
description: Adds Warped Wart as a counterpart to Nether Wart (now Crimson Wart).
body:

[![GitHub issues](https://img.shields.io/badge/github-issues-brightgreen?logo=github&style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/muhammadrizo-y/warped-wart/issues)
![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg?style=for-the-badge)

Adds Warped Wart as a counterpart to Nether Wart (now Crimson Wart). 

This mod is mainly exists because it's a dependency for two of my mods: [Blocksistency](https://modrinth.com/mod/blocksistency) and one other new mod. You don't have to install this mod because it will be included in the jar file for both mods. You can still install it if you only want the Warped Wart feature.

## Features:
- Warped Wart crop
- Warped Wart item
- Nether Wart crop, item and block are now renamed to "Crimson"
- Warped Wart generates in Nether Fortresses alongside Crimson Wart
- Warped Wart can be used in the Brewing Stand, same functionality as Crimson Wart
- Planting Warped Wart can now trigger the "A Seedy Place" advancement

## Installation

**🛠️ INSTALLATION REQUIRED ON BOTH CLIENT AND SERVER**

**📦 REQUIRES [FABRIC API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) TO BE INSTALLED**
